## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Southern-Sòng *shānjiā* doctrinal treatise by **Běifēng Zōngyìn** 北峰宗印 (1148–1213). Zōngyìn was the teacher of **Huìyán Fǎzhào** 晦巖法照 ([法照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%85%A7)) and of **Gǔyún Yuáncuì** 古雲元粹 ([元粹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%B2%B9)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Zōngyìn's productive period c. 1180–1213.
